# Step 1.1: Finalize provenance verification

## What this patch does

It replaces `scripts/otlp-sync.sh` and `scripts/otlp-verify.sh` and adds a checksum manifest during a fresh, pinned upstream sync. The manifest is stored at `schemas/otlp-sha256.txt`, **outside** the vendored source directory. The validator checks file hashes, revision metadata, and the upstream license without contacting the network.

## Apply the patch

From the repository root, after copying these scripts:

```bash
# This is safe only if schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto contains the Step 1.1
# files generated by the original sync script and you have no local edits there.
# Review first: git status --short schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto
rm -rf schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto
rm -f schemas/otlp-sha256.txt
bash scripts/otlp-sync.sh
bash scripts/otlp-verify.sh
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
```

`otlp-sync.sh` verifies the exact tag commit before copying files and generating the checksum manifest. The detached HEAD notification from Git is normal. Do not regenerate the manifest to hide unexplained modifications; investigate differences first.

## Confirm tamper detection

```bash
cp schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto/opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.proto /tmp/request-xray-trace.proto.backup
printf '\n// deliberate verification test\n' >> schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto/opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.proto
if bash scripts/otlp-verify.sh; then
  echo 'ERROR: verifier missed modification' >&2
  exit 1
else
  echo 'Expected: modified protobuf detected'
fi
cp /tmp/request-xray-trace.proto.backup schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto/opentelemetry/proto/trace/v1/trace.proto
bash scripts/otlp-verify.sh
```

## Commit

```bash
git add Cargo.lock crates/xray-otlp docs/OTLP_PROTOBUF.md docs/STEP_1_1_FINALIZE.md \
  scripts/otlp-sync.sh scripts/otlp-verify.sh schemas/vendor/opentelemetry-proto schemas/otlp-sha256.txt
git diff --cached --check
git status --short
git commit -m "feat(otlp): pin upstream protobuf and verify vendored hashes"
git push
```

## Security note

The initial trusted sync verifies upstream tag to a pinned commit. SHA-256 detects later accidental or unauthorized changes against the tracked manifest. Since both the source and manifest can be changed in one commit, code review and Git history remain part of the trust boundary. The dependency lockfile pins generator dependencies. For further supply-chain assurance, verify upstream tag signatures/release provenance separately.
